facts.claim: 'A Thousand Years' is performed by Christina Perri; it first entered the UK Official Singles Chart on 19/11/2011 on the Atlantic label (2011 release year).
'A Thousand Years' by Christina Perri peaked at Number 11 on the UK Official Singles Chart (peak week 28/09/2013).
'A Thousand Years' by Christina Perri peaked at Number 10 on the UK Official Singles Downloads Chart and at Number 13 on the UK Official Singles Sales Chart.
Adele's recording of 'Make You Feel My Love' first entered the UK Official Singles Chart on 25/10/2008 on the XL Recordings label (2008 release year).
Adele's 'Make You Feel My Love' peaked at Number 4 on the UK Official Singles Chart (peak week 09/10/2010) and reached Number 1 on the UK Official Independent Singles Chart.
The Library of Congress National Recording Registry lists 'At Last' (single) by Etta James with the year 1961, in the R&B category.
The Library of Congress FY2009 annual report states Etta James's 'At Last!' was named to the National Recording Registry in June 2009.
GRAMMY.com states Rascal Flatts' 'Bless The Broken Road' earned the group a GRAMMY nomination for 2005 for Best Country Performance By A Duo Or Group With Vocal.
Billboard reports Rascal Flatts' 'Bless the Broken Road' spent five weeks at No. 1 on Billboard's Hot Country Songs chart.
Russell Dickerson's official site lists 'Yours' among his No. 1 hits and describes it as 3X Platinum.
Billboard describes 'Yours' as Russell Dickerson's debut hit and reports it reached No. 1 on Billboard's Country Airplay chart (two weeks from January 2018).
